name: Associated Press Stylebook Augmenter
description: Provides a plugin to adjust date output to meet the Associated Press Stylebook guidelines

suggests.drupal/smart_date: For a compatible date formatter and the bundled AP Stylebook Smart Date format

project_description:
Provides some just-in-time date/time formatting adjustments to meet Associated Press (AP) Stylebook guidelines.

 
 Convert meridians (a.m. or p.m.) to be always lowercase with periods between characters. 
 Expand months that are less than six letters, and abbreviate September as Sept. 
 Replace the time figures with the words noon and midnight when appropriate. 
 
 Although all of these rules are enabled by default, there are options to disable specific rules you don't need. Additionally, this module provides a Smart Date format designed to help your output conform to AP Stylebook standards for date and time output.

 The Associated Press (AP) is not directly associated with this module.

 Similar modules 
 AP Style Date - Output date fields in the AP Style. This module now provides support for smart_date range field types, which AP Stylebook Date Augmenter originally set out to provide.
